name: S1 public-panic-contracts
text: Many public constructors and setters `assert!` on values app authors pass (Size::new, wheel/viewport/draggable extents, force-press pressures, tension, time dilation, drag boundaries, Canvas restore/finish, reactive mutation checks, memo cycles, CustomMultiChildLayout lookups). AGENTS.md requires a documented `# Panics` contract plus a `maybe_*`/`try_*` pair, or a structured error. Fix per type: add `# Panics` docs, add `try_new`/`maybe_*` returning a small typed error, keep the panicking form as a thin wrapper. Public API additions only (non-breaking). Findings tagged `systemic:public-panic-contracts`.

name: S2 listener-snapshot
text: Listener lists are cloned into a fresh `Vec` on every notification so callbacks can re-enter (animation controller, scroll notifications, draggable sheet extents, back-gesture registry). Fix: store listeners as `Rc<[(u64, Listener)]>` rebuilt copy-on-write on subscribe/unsubscribe, so dispatch clones one `Rc`. Best as a small shared helper (e.g. `incular_core::listeners::ListenerList<F>`) used by every site. Behavior is identical (snapshot semantics preserved).

name: S3 restoration-clone
text: Scroll state clones its `ScrollRestoration`/`RestorationKey` (owns a `String`) on every moved jump, ballistic tick and physics update to persist the offset. Fix: hold the restoration binding as `Rc<ScrollRestoration>` (or make the key `Rc<str>`) so persistence is a refcount bump, or persist through a borrow. Touches incular-scroll controller/activity/physics/coordinator.

name: S4 route-outlet-frame
text: `route_outlet.rs` rebuilds route snapshots every frame: `Navigator::routes()` collects a `Vec<Route>` (called ~3x per frame), plus visibility Vec, live HashSet, order Vec, exiting clone, barrier clone and tag `Key::String` clones. Fix: add a borrowing accessor on Navigator (`with_routes(|&[Route]|)` / route ids), keep scratch collections on `RouteAnimations`, and compare revisions before rebuilding. Needs a frame benchmark before/after (navigation_showcase).

name: S5 renderer-frame-scratch
text: The renderer and compositor allocate fresh containers each frame: lowering stacks, batch lists and instance Vecs, backdrop planning HashMaps, glyph page maps, composition bound stacks, leader publish maps, resource use lists. Fix: per-renderer scratch structs cleared and reused each frame. Restructuring, so per the audit rules it needs a benchmark (`benchmarks/`, performance_gallery) and is a design follow-up, not a mechanical edit.

name: S6 layout-scratch
text: Several layout algorithms allocate per-layout scratch (wrap runs, table row heights, two-dimensional viewport child maps, animated/tree sliver position lists). Layout runs only for dirty subtrees, so cost is modest; fix with scratch fields on the render object or SmallVec. Benchmark before changing.

name: S7 refcell-across-callback
text: RefCell borrows are held while calling app-supplied code (tree sliver row builder, back dispatcher, router provider subscription, draggable sheet physics). A callback that touches the same state panics with `BorrowMutError`. Fix: copy what is needed out of the borrow, drop it, then call. These are latent bugs, so fix them first.

name: S8 id-generator
text: ~20 copies of `AtomicU64::try_update` ID generators across crates (core context/key/reactivity, runtime, widgets, image, rendering, scroll, devtools). Fix: one `incular_core::id::next_id(&AtomicU64)` helper or a `IdGenerator` type; mechanical.
